label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — The sink expression is obj[1], populated by bar. Tracing the executed path: param holds user input. valuesList becomes ['safe', param, 'moresafe']. valuesList.remove(0) removes 'safe'. Then bar = valuesList.get(1) retrieves the element at index 1, which is now the user-controlled 'param'. Thus, the resolved sink value is attacker-controlled user input. The subsequent call to response.getWriter().format(...) writes this tainted value directly to the HTML response without sanitization. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.

evidence.note: User input flows from param into valuesList, remove(0) shifts indices, and bar gets assigned valuesList.get(1) which resolves to the original user input.
Tainted bar is placed in obj array and written to HTML response via format(), causing XSS.
